_readme: Append-only log. Newest entries may go anywhere; page sorts by date desc. type: baseline | fee-change | spread-change | policy-change | no-change. Never invent changes; cite a source URL accessed on the entry date.

entries.summary: Model correction: Strike fee FAQ documents a target all-in spread of 0.22% on buys/sells, separate from the recurring trading-fee waiver. Changed spreadEstimatePct from 0% (documented) to 0.22% (estimate). Recurring path at $100/wk moves from ~$0.89/yr (first-buy fee only) to ~$12.33/yr (first-buy 0.89% + 0.22%×52).
Baseline verification: recurring weekly DCA fee 0% after first purchase; standard buy fee 0.89% applies to first buy. No spread for this path per Strike.
Baseline verification: recurring-buy fee 0% as modeled; spread ~0% is a StackCost estimate (not published).
Baseline verification: auto-purchase fee 1.0%; no separate spread per Swan's documented pricing.
Baseline verification: recurring-buy fee modeled at 1.49%; spread ~0.5% is a StackCost estimate.
Baseline verification: buy fee modeled at 1.0%; spread ~0.5% is a StackCost estimate.
Baseline verification: auto-invest fee modeled at 0% with no separate spread for the modeled path, per Cash App disclosures.

Baseline added: recurring BTC buy on default market maker routing has no commission. Robinhood discloses receiving $0.95 per $100 of market-maker-routed crypto volume (as of 2026-06-15), included in the spread; modeled as a 0.95% spread ESTIMATE (floor). Exchange routing alternative: 0.95% taker fee at $0–$10K volume.

Baseline added: Recurring Buy fee 2.00% for $75.00–$200.00 orders (2.20% under $75; 1.80% $200.01–$1,000; 1.50% above). Spread modeled at PayPal's own stated estimate of 1.00% (ESTIMATE). Venmo lists the identical crypto fee table but documents no general recurring BTC buy.

Model correction: River's help center documents that buy orders include a spread that typically falls around 0.25% (sells ~0.50%), separate from the recurring-buy fee waiver. Changed spreadEstimatePct from 0% to 0.25% (estimate). Recurring path at $100/wk moves from ~$1.00/yr (first-buy fee only) to ~$14.00/yr (first-buy 1.00% + 0.25%×52). River's fee page (updated 2026-10-23) still shows 0% recurring fee from the 2nd weekly order and 1.00% standard fee.

Baseline added: Fold now has one free plan (membership dropped 2026-10-20). Without a $5,000+ Reserve balance a 1% fee applies to buys and sells including automated buys, plus undisclosed Fold/BitGo spreads (modeled 0.5% ESTIMATE). With $5,000+ Reserve, Fold fee and added spread are 0% (BitGo market spread remains); Fold charges no withdrawal fee.

Strike's trading-fees FAQ now says it targets an all-in spread of 0.21% (was 0.22%). Updated spreadEstimatePct from 0.22% to 0.21% (estimate). Recurring path at $100/wk moves from ~$12.33/yr to ~$11.81/yr (first-buy 0.89% + 0.21%×52). One-time fee tiers unchanged: 0.89% at ≤$4,999.99 monthly volume, 0.79% at $5,000–$49,999.99, down to 0.25% at ≥$15M; a single trade counts toward its own tier.

One-time Market Buy baseline (for StackCost's one-time buy pages): 2.0% at $1–$499, 1.5% at $500–$999, 0.9% at $1,000–$1,999, 0% at $2,000+; spread 0–0.75% except buys over $2,000 and Auto Invest/Round Ups/direct deposit (zero spread). Auto Invest remains 0% fee and 0% spread.
Re-verified: one-time orders up to $1,000,000 pay 1.00% (0.70% $1M–$5M, 0.40% $5M–$15M, 0.25% $15M+); recurring buys 0% from the second weekly order. Page still dated 2026-10-23.
